# BeRocker

> BeRocker is an AI-powered CRM built specifically for auto transport (car shipping) brokers in the United States. It covers the full brokerage workflow in one platform: lead intake, AI pricing, omnichannel customer communication (SMS, calls, email, WhatsApp), load board posting to Super Dispatch and Central Dispatch, carrier offers, and dispatch.

Key facts:
- Product: web-based CRM (works on desktop, tablet, and phone — the full workspace, not a cut-down mobile app)
- Audience: auto transport brokers and brokerages of any size
- Pricing: Pro plan $199/month (base license + 1 seat included; additional seats $69/each, $59/each beyond 5 seats; Super Dispatch API subscription included free — a $250 value). Enterprise plan: custom pricing with dedicated server, white label on your own custom domain, deeper customizations, and prioritized support.
- BeRocker does not sell, generate, or offer leads to customers — it manages the leads brokers already buy or generate.
- AI integrations: BeRocker offers Claude and ChatGPT MCP (Model Context Protocol) connections, so agents can work with a brokerage's CRM data directly.

## Core capabilities

- Lead intake: leads from lead providers, the broker's own website, parsed emails, and on-site widgets arrive structured and assigned automatically
- AI pricing: compare BeRocker AI pricing with Super Dispatch and Central Dispatch side by side before quoting
- Omnichannel communication: SMS, phone calls with recordings and transcriptions, email, and WhatsApp Business in a single conversation timeline; brokers keep their existing phone numbers and email providers
- Load boards: one-click posting of shipment-ready loads to Super Dispatch, Central Dispatch, or both
- Dispatch: carrier offers, bid comparison, one-click dispatch, and tracking in one workflow
- Analytics: pre-built KPI dashboards and reports designed for auto transport operations
- Growth tools: professional booking website, email campaigns, e-sign contracts, customer portals
- AI broker assistant: automated quoting, follow-ups, and 24/7 conversation handling
